firstPlayerRule: Give the Start Player token to whoever can shout the most piratical “Arrrr!”. That player takes the first turn.
clarifications: All players draw cards simultaneously before turns begin, then turns proceed clockwise from the token holder.
Pass the Start Player token clockwise at the end of each round.

internalEvidence: The Alley Cat Games English rulebook linked from Board Game Circus's publisher download list was retrieved for inventory BGG identity 234450. Printed/PDF pages 5, 6, 11 and 16 were rendered and visually checked. Page 5 awards the Start Player token for the most piratical Arrrr; page 6 confirms simultaneous card draw before the token holder's first clockwise turn; page 11 passes the token clockwise after each round. Page 16 credits Alley Cat Games ©2018. Publisher-partner PDF SHA-256: 17013bd397a602288bb3407e2824c375ee176f9476355357b75e791f7249f444. Owner-authorized Codex editorial review, 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The booklet supplies no objective standard or tie-break for judging the most piratical shout.
